title: Small steps: Hear the sentence twice
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: hear the words as information and as possible impact
principle: Consider how one sentence may communicate more than its literal instruction.
nextSentence: The mistake needs useful feedback. First, hear the words as information and as possible impact.
keyLearning: Consider how one sentence may communicate more than its literal instruction.
